adds.title: Asher & Lyric LGBTQ+ Danger Index 2023, Gay Travel Index 2024, Equaldex Equality Index 2024
adds.summary: In 2024 Canada — including Nova Scotia — shared first place with Malta, New Zealand, Spain and Portugal as the most LGBT+-friendly travel destination among 213 countries and regions, covering lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and intersex people.
